_comment: Applied by stage_packs.mjs to every loose (OPEN/NONE) pack's HANDLING_FILE, per <handlingName> (case-insensitive).
scale: value *= factor; set: value = number. Every listed field must exist exactly once in that handling item, or staging fails.
'*' applies to every handlingName in a loose pack, before the named entry (the named entry can override).
GI 2026-11-05: acceleration -33 % on every car (with the engine's power multiplier, libs/sync/hypertune.h), handling +15 %,
rs6 / bmwm5 hit the ground and shake: more ride height and compression travel, firmer springs and bump damping.
NG/AES packs keep their own handling.meta (the game reads it from the encrypted dlc.rpf); only the engine's power row tunes them.

rs6._why: power 1.5 -> 1.0 in the engine = -33 %, drive force unchanged; travel 0.07 -> 0.11, raise +0.03 m

bmwm5._why: power 1.45 -> 1.0 (-31 %) and drive x0.97 = -33 %; raise +0.03 m, firmer springs and bump damping

LP700R._why: travel 0.062 -> 0.09 (rs6 bottomed out at 0.07), firmer bump damping

M3GTR._why: travel 0.05 -> 0.09, raise +0.02 m; max flat vel 410 -> 300 (a road car); min traction above max (5.29 vs 4.08) -> 0.9 x max

mbc63s._why: travel 0.06 -> 0.09; drive x0.85 (0.38 out-accelerated the RS6 at 0.35 and 1925 kg)

mbe420._why: drive x0.67 = -33 % (0.30 at 1600 kg out-accelerated the RS6; a 279 hp E420)

mbg63._why: an SUV on 0.05 m of travel: 0.12 (Dubsta-like), raise +0.03 m, firmer bump damping

teslas._why: drive 0.55 on one gear is the strongest street car in the set: x0.67 = -33 %

valkyrietp._why: travel 0.03 and raise -0.005 bottom out on any kerb: 0.08 and 0; max flat vel 430 -> 360 (350 km/h car)
